name: project-manager
description: Multi-project management tool with AI-agent integration

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
